Thanks — quick clarifications from security/legal:
- Residency: we require EU residency for EU customer accounts and proof of data-at-rest location (not just transit).
- Deletion window: must be 90 days for user-level data; backups can be retained longer but must be isolated and subject to documented retention policies.
- KMS: we prefer customer-managed keys (CMK) or at minimum bring-your-own-key (BYOK) arrangement.

Also: can you confirm whether audit log retention is configurable and whether logs can be exported to our SIEM?

If you can confirm these in writing and provide the SIG evidence, we can keep to the target timeline.

Sam
